title: Regional Switchover Simulator and Readiness Play
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a deterministic regional switchover simulator and a preflight readiness playbook that validates tier routing, KV prefill, and fallback model variant compatibility before any cross-region cutover. The simulator should be runnable in CI and from the console, exercise realistic request distributions (latency, size, kv-hit ratio), and produce a detailed readiness report that maps to an automated rollback/abort decision matrix.
acceptance_criteria: A runnable simulator binary and CI job that replays 10K synthetic requests across two regions with configurable latency/packet-loss profiles
A readiness report that includes metrics: cold_kv_fill_time, standby_kv_fill_ratio, model_variant_latency_penalty, routing_fallback_score
Automated pass/fail gates that can abort a staged switchover when standby_confidence < 0.85 or p95 latency increases by > 30%
Documentation (Confluence) with runbook, required observability dashboards and Slack incident channel wiring
A minimal canary script that performs a 1% traffic diversion to standby and validates correctness in 15 minutes
runbook_steps: 2) Verify synthetic traffic reaches primary and standby via swarm-socket logs (tag: switchover-sim)
3) Ensure KV prefill task completes and standby_kv_fill_ratio >= 0.9 within configured window
4) Execute model fallback drill: force primary to return 503 and confirm automatic routing to fallback_variant table
5) Run correctness checks: sample outputs from fallback variant must pass the overlap/eval threshold defined in the fallback matrix
6) If simulated p95 latency > threshold or standby_confidence < 0.85, abort and follow rollback checklist
7) Post-mortem: attach simulator run archive and annotated logs to PR and confluence page
telemetry_and_alerts: Create synthetic job: telemetry/synthetics/switchover-sim (30m cadence) producing switchover_run_id and run_status
Introduce metric: standby_kv_fill_ratio (gauge) with tags region, model_variant, route_tier
Add histogram: model_variant_latency_penalty_ms with pre and post percentiles
Add alert: standby_confidence_drop when value falls below 0.85 for 5m -> pager to oncall
Dashboard: switchover-readiness (p95 latency, kv_fill_ratio, fallback_success_rate, failed_routing_count)
testing_plan: Unit tests for simulator workload generator (deterministic seeds)
Integration test in staging: 2-region replay with production-like request mix and real model binaries
Chaos test: inject 10% packet loss and verify canary abort logic triggers
Manual review: PM + SRE walkthrough of first three simulator runs and readiness reports
Final signoff: runbook owner to approve before any prod failover exercise
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (lab): run simulator locally and validate metrics (Dev team)
Phase 1 (staging): enable CI job and baseline a 72h synthetic run (SRE + Eng)
Phase 2 (canary): 1% traffic diversion using canary-script for 15m with auto-abort gates
Phase 3 (gradual): 10% -> 50% -> 100% traffic stepping with automated checks at each stage
Emergency rollback: immediate revert to prior routing-policy and purge any partial KV prefill artifacts
notes: Design decision: simulator will intentionally model KV as 'N shards' with configurable cold/warm ratio instead of trying to mirror exact cache implementation. This keeps test deterministic and easier to interpret.
Trade-off: we will not prepopulate user-specific encrypted caches in simulator due to KMS constraints; instead we validate content-agnostic KV fill semantics.
Follow-up: add a microbenchmark to quantify model variant latency penalty under 4-bit quantized kernels (ENG-REPORT-qb1)
Ops ask: SRE to allocate a staging two-region fleet for 48h for validation runs (ticket created in infra queue)
